purpose: Freeze exactly one source-aligned implementation candidate: preserve the standard same-run raw GNSS-first native FGO position/clock/velocity staging and initialize only the main Pose3+IMU C0/D drift state from the retained raw Android receiver clock drift.

forbidden_flags: any result-file, MAT, truth, device-WLS, or precomputed-coordinate input

handoff_contract.gnss_first_mode: standard native raw GNSS-first FGO pass, not velocity-only and not direct-WLS
handoff_contract.gnss_first_problem_instance: the same in-memory raw problem retained for the main graph; no independently rebuilt handoff vector
handoff_contract.gnss_first_c0d: C0/D factor and active-solve diagnostic remain disabled in the non-Pose3 GNSS-first initializer, as in the existing path
handoff_contract.position_handoff: copy the finite GNSS-first optimized positions into the same in-memory main problem
handoff_contract.clock_handoff: copy the finite GNSS-first optimized receiver clock bias into the same in-memory main problem using the existing metre convention
handoff_contract.velocity_handoff: pass the finite GNSS-first optimized velocity sequence in memory to buildImuInput and the main Pose3+IMU graph
handoff_contract.source_staging_identity: raw GNSS P+D -> native GNSS-only FGO state -> native GNSS+IMU FGO state

exact_epoch_alignment.count: GNSS-first solutions and velocity states must equal the retained main problem epoch count
exact_epoch_alignment.raw_utc_key: each GNSS-first state must carry the identical raw Android UTC millisecond key of the corresponding retained epoch
exact_epoch_alignment.gnss_time: each state must carry identical GNSS week and TOW to the corresponding retained EpochSeed
exact_epoch_alignment.existing_time_equality: GNSSTime week/TOW equality may be used only as an asserted source-key check; no broader tolerance is introduced

main_graph_d_initializer.source_provenance: raw Android ObservationData receiver drift carried through EpochSeed
main_graph_d_initializer.required_count: exactly one finite raw drift value for every retained main-graph epoch
main_graph_d_initializer.GNSS_first_initializer_D_behavior: unchanged; this candidate modifies only main-graph D_i

preserved_contract.direct_quality_parameters: unchanged source P/D quality, SNR model, residual masks, and public route-independent settings
preserved_contract.measurement_factors: unchanged raw P/D, IMU, and existing C0/D factors
preserved_contract.active_solve_telemetry: preserve Phase88 telemetry and fail-closed termination gates

required_focused_tests_before_any_execut: Synthetic exact epoch alignment accepts identical retained UTC/week/TOW keys and rejects missing, duplicate, reordered, nearest, interpolated, padded, and count-mismatched handoff states.
Synthetic Android DriftNanosPerSecond conversion produces the expected finite m/s D seed.
Synthetic missing/nonfinite raw drift fails closed without zero, hold, interpolation, WLS, residual, coordinate, or PDC fallback.
Synthetic standard GNSS-first in-memory handoff preserves finite position/clock/velocity state provenance and does not read a result file or coordinate artifact.
Synthetic main-graph D initializer changes only D_i; GNSS-first position/clock/velocity staging and raw P/D factor values remain unchanged.
Synthetic C0/D factor verifies unchanged equation, Jacobian, sigma, edge skips, phone exclusions, and row accounting.
Synthetic diagnostics prove the candidate cannot enable direct-WLS, velocity-only, PDC, base, or external/precomputed-coordinate paths.
Active-solve evaluator tests retain finite-cost, iterations-at-least-one, and strictly-decreasing-final-cost fail-closed gates.
required_gates_before_any_future_raw_exe: Implementation, focused tests, and candidate selector are committed after this freeze.
A separate pre-raw execution manifest pins implementation source, binary, evaluator, candidate flag, raw inputs, and exact routes.
The evaluator verifies exact UTC/GNSS epoch alignment, finite full raw D coverage, same-run handoff provenance, no PDC/external coordinates, and unchanged C0/D/direct-quality contracts.
The evaluator fails closed on missing active telemetry, iterations below one, nonfinite costs, final cost not strictly below initial cost, or any handoff invariant failure.
No truth, MAT, Kaggle, token, base, validation-holdout, Phase82, result-file, device-WLS, or precomputed-coordinate read is permitted.
No accuracy score or route-score selection is permitted.
candidate.evidence_limit: Phase85 proves the standard GNSS-first staging reached complete state sequences, while Phase86 proves the later main graph failed active-solve gates. The new raw-D initializer is supported as a source-unit/provenance correction hypothesis only; no route readiness or accuracy improvement is claimed.

future_raw_domain_if_separately_authoriz.future_route_matrix: must be separately frozen; this record authorizes zero routes

forbidden_inputs_and_behaviors: native PDC state bridge or PDC-derived initializer
base RINEX, base coordinate, or external coordinate-bearing input
device WLS coordinates or any result-file coordinate/clock/velocity input
MAT/MATLAB products, truth, validation holdout, Phase82 artifacts, Kaggle data, or tokens
raw D replacement from residuals, coordinates, velocity differences, or historical phone-list preprocessing
D zero/hold/interpolation/WLS fallback when raw drift is absent or invalid
coordinate copy from any source other than the same-run in-memory GNSS-first result
source equation, sigma, direct-quality, rank, residual, physical, coverage, optimizer, or termination-gate relaxation
accuracy scoring, route-score selection, or promotion

output/reproducibility-cache/gsdc2023/fg.evidence: Official GNSS-first result supplies posini, velini, clk, and dclk; those initialize the GNSS+IMU graph's position, velocity, clock, and drift states before P/D, C0/D, and IMU factors.

output/reproducibility-cache/gsdc2023/fu.evidence: Official Android DriftNanosPerSecond conversion is c * drift / 1e9 in metres/second.

output/reproducibility-cache/gsdc2023/pa.evidence: Official C0/D motion-clock sigma is 0.1 metres.

output/reproducibility-cache/gtsam_gnss/.evidence: Official metre-valued C0/D equation and Jacobian.

apps/native/gnss_fgo_imu_no_base.cpp.evidence: Standard mode keeps one in-memory GNSS-first problem, copies position/clock unless velocity-only is selected, and passes velocity to IMU; direct-WLS and velocity-only branches are distinct.

src/algorithms/fgo_problems.cpp.evidence: Raw receiver drift is carried into EpochSeed; direct-WLS is computed upstream of the main graph and is not part of this candidate.

src/algorithms/fgo_gtsam_backend.cpp.evidence: Main IMU D states currently use PDC or zero, while velocity/pose seeds and unchanged C0/D rows are inserted separately.

src/io/android_raw_gnss.cpp.evidence: Raw DriftNanosPerSecond is parsed and converted to m/s, with NaN preserved when absent.

implementation_authorization.authorized_scope: Only main-graph D_i initialization from same retained raw Android receiver_clock_drift_mps plus the mandatory alignment/provenance diagnostics and tests.
implementation_authorization.failure_action: Fail closed; preserve the standard in-memory GNSS-first handoff and all source C0/D, direct-quality, optimizer, no-PDC, no-external-coordinate, and active-solve gates.
